snippet.title: Los BANCOS se están preparando discretamente para el golpe del SÚPER NIÑO @VisualEconomik
snippet.description:
📈 Empieza a invertir desde Hispanoamérica con XTB: https://geolink.xtb.com/OGjo3

#Publicidad

Tiburones en la costa de California, un monzón muy seco en la India, la pesca de Perú hundida a la mitad y el azúcar un 25 % más caro en los mercados de futuros. Todo tiene la misma causa: el Súper Niño. Este año, el agua de esa franja del Pacífico está casi tres grados por encima de la media de las últimas décadas, y la NOAA no descarta que sea el más potente desde que hay registros.

El precedente más parecido es el de 1997, que según los estudios costó casi 6 billones de dólares a la economía mundial. En la región del ecuador, desde Perú hasta Filipinas, un Súper Niño puede recortar el PIB per cápita más de un 5 % durante varios años. El Peterson Institute calcula que el de este año podría tener un impacto inicial de un billón de dólares, y que las pérdidas a cinco años podrían superar los 7 billones.

En este vídeo os contamos cómo afecta a cada región, por qué los bancos son uno de los sectores más preocupados, qué pasará con el níquel, el azúcar y la cesta de la compra, y por qué el comercio y la adaptación del campo pueden hacer que esta vez el golpe sea menor de lo que dicen las previsiones.

Behind the appearance of an ordinary family lies a world of complicated relationships, unresolved resentment, and hidden conspiracies. Sufiyan Hamdani's two marriages have created divisions that continue to affect his family. 

While he has always been deeply attached to his second wife, Saira, and their daughters, Mishaal and Eshaal, his relationship with his first wife, Zainab, and their sons, Asim and Salman, has remained distant. Following the tragic loss of Saira and his mother, Sufiyan Hamdani brings his daughters into Zainab's home, where their arrival sets off a chain of unexpected conflicts.

As Salman falls in love with Malahat, his father's disapproval becomes a major obstacle, while Eshaal's interference threatens to destroy their relationship. Meanwhile, Mishaal's marriage to Hassan faces its own challenges as the couple struggles to navigate growing tensions and complications in their married life. 

Eshaal develops feelings for Ammar, Hassan's cousin, but her emotions remain unreciprocated as Ammar begins showing interest in Malahat, further complicating the already strained relationships.

Will Salman and Malahat overcome the obstacles standing between them?
Will Eshaal succeed in winning Ammar's heart despite his feelings for Malahat?

बीड जिल्ह्यात दुष्काळाची तीव्रता वाढत असताना आता फळबागा जगवण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्यांची मोठी धडपड सुरूय... आष्टी तालुक्यातील पारगाव जोगेश्वरी इथले शेतकरी रामनाथ मोकाशे यांना दोन एकर लिंबू आणि अडीच एकर डाळिंबाची बाग वाचवण्यासाठी  दोन ते तीन टँकर पाणी विकत घ्यावं लागतंय... एका टँकरसाठी ३०० रुपये मोजून हे पाणी विहिरीत आणि शेततळ्यात साठवलं जातंय... 

The drought situation in Beed district is worsening, forcing farmers to struggle to save their fruit orchards. In Pargaon Jogeshwari village of Ashti taluka, farmer Ramnath Mokashe is purchasing water tankers to protect his two-acre lemon orchard and two-and-a-half-acre pomegranate orchard. He has to arrange two to three water tankers and pay ₹300 for each tanker. The purchased water is stored in wells and farm ponds to keep the orchards alive. With water scarcity intensifying, farmers are facing growing financial pressure to save their crops.

snippet.description:
Altı Üstü İstanbul 22.Bölümü izlemek için: https://youtu.be/PXi--kg9PtM
#AltıÜstüİstanbul

22.Bölüm Özeti:
Hasan ölümle burun buruna gelirken Uzay, bencilliğine rağmen kaçmayı başaramaz. Uzay’dan hesap sormaya hazırlanan Emir ve arkadaşları büyük bir duvara toslar. İzledikleri görüntülerden sonra hiçbir şey eskisi gibi olmayacaktır. Ne çiftler için ne de Hasan için.  
Rami’nin yaralanması ise Fahriye’yi duygularıyla yüzleşmeye zorlarken Gülten ve Soner’in varlığı işleri iyice karıştırır. Melek ise ailesiyle bağları kopma noktasına gelirken henüz son sözünü söylemeye niyeti yoktur.
Cezaevinde yaşananlar Hasan’ın geçmişteki yaralarını yeniden açarken; Emir, kardeşi için kendisini feda etmeye hazırdır. Naz ise çırpınıyordur Emir için. Ne kadar kırgın olsa da Emir, Naz onu yalnız bırakmamaya kararlıdır.
Tüm bunlar olurken Zafer kazandığını zanneden Uzay’ı da büyük bir sürpriz bekliyordur. Hiç ummadığı anda Hasan’la aynı cezaevine düşerler…
İkisinin de bilmediği şey ise kaderin ikisi için de başka bir planı olduğudur.


"Altı Üstü İstanbul", İstanbul’un kenar mahallesinde yaşayan Emir’in bir grup arkadaşıyla birlikte hayallerine ulaşma mücadelesini konu alıyor. Güç, para ve ihanetin gölgesinde yolları kesişen gençler, attıkları her adımla birbirlerinin kaderini değiştirecek geri dönüşü olmayan seçimlerle yüzleşecek.
 
Dostlukların sınandığı, aşkların yön değiştirdiği ve herkesin kendi yolunu seçtiğini sandığı hikâyede, aslında hiçbir kararın tek başına alınmadığı ortaya çıkacak.

The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.description:
How Yuzvendra Chahal Suddenly Became BJP's OBC Morcha Leader? #shorts 

Yuzvendra Chahal's reported association with the BJP has sparked a debate after he was given a role in the party's OBC Morcha.

A celebrated Indian cricketer who has represented the country on the international stage is now being discussed in the context of caste-based political representation. This raises an interesting question: why does political identity so often revolve around caste categories, even when the individual is known for achievements beyond them?

From slogans like "Ek Hai Toh Safe Hai" and "Batenge Toh Katenge" to the political emphasis on Vanchit, Bahujan, OBC and Savarna identities, we examine the role caste continues to play in Indian politics.

Should public figures primarily be recognised for their achievements, or does caste-based representation remain an important part of political mobilisation?
